menu_options.discover: Search the MQTT broker for devices

discover.title: Discovered Newtron devices
discover.description: Select the device to add. Only devices that answered on the broker are listed.

manual.title: Newtron card serial number
manual.description: Enter the serial number of the card, as shown on its label, e.g. SMART16R-1504. Home Assistant finds the card on the MQTT broker by itself.

confirm.title: Newtron card found
confirm.description: Card {serial} ({board}) is online on the broker under topic {topic}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.no_response: No card connected to this broker answered with this serial number. Check the number and that the card is connected to this broker.

abort.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up. Configure it first.
abort.already_in_progress: This card is already being added.
